document.title: State 215948 (Frankfurt meetings on bin Laden with Taliban Deputy Foreign Minister)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Mullah Omar Called Washington in 1998, New Documents Show
document.note: Discusses meetings about bin Laden held in Frankfurt, Germany on 2-3 November 2000 between senior U.S. officials Alan Eastham and Edmund Hill and Taliban Deputy Foreign Minister Abdul Jalil.

mentions.quote: TALEBAN DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER JALIL MET WITH SENIOR US OFFICIALS ALAN EASTHAM AND EDMUND HULL IN FRANKFURT, GERMANY NOV 2-3
SO THAT HE COULD USE THIS WITH MULLAH OMAR AND OTHERS IN ADVANCE
THE TALEBAN SIMPLY WANTED TO GET RID OF HIM

persons.name: Alan Eastham
persons.role: US State Dept SA Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary (PDAS); led interagency group

mentions.quote: AN INTERAGENCY GROUP LED BY SA PDAS ALAN EASTHAM AND S/CT DEPUTY COORDINATOR EDMUND HULL
EASTHAM NOTED THAT JALIL HAD REFERRED EARLIER TO THE EVENTS OF 1998

persons.name: Edmund Hull
persons.role: S/CT (Office of the Coordinator for Counterterrorism) Deputy Coordinator

mentions.quote: HULL NOTED THAT THE US HAD PROVIDED THE US INDICTMENT OF UBL TO JALIL IN MAY
HULL ADDED THAT THERE WERE OTHER TERRORIST GROUPS ACTIVE IN AFGHANISTAN BESIDES UBL AND AL QAIDA

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: al-Qa'ida leader, indicted by US, sheltered in Afghanistan

mentions.quote: MET WITH SENIOR US OFFICIALS ... TO DISCUSS THE USAMA BIN LADEN (UBL) ISSUE
UBL IS OUR ENEMY--WE DON'T WANT HIM AND YOU DON'T WANT HIM
USE THIS WITH MULLAH OMAR AND OTHERS IN ADVANCE TO CONVINCE THEM
MULLAH OMAR HAD ORDERED A BAN ON PRODUCTION
JALIL MAY MEET AMBASSADOR MILAM IN ISLAMABAD ON HIS RETURN TRIP TO AFGHANISTAN

persons.name: Thomas Pickering
persons.role: US Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs

mentions.quote: JALIL'S OWN MEETING WITH UNDER SECRETARY PICKERING IN MAY
THIS WAS EVIDENT IN U/S PICKERING'S DISCUSSIONS IN MOSCOW

events.description: Eastham and Hull (with Lunstead) met Taliban Deputy FM Jalil in Frankfurt to discuss UBL; Jalil asked for a US 'gesture'.
Second day of Frankfurt talks; themes repeated; Eastham said retaliation targets infrastructure, not individuals, and preferred law.
Jalil met Under Secretary Pickering; US provided UBL indictment to Jalil; four issues raised.
Jalil met Ambassador Milam in Islamabad, after which he asked for the Frankfurt meeting.
East Africa US embassy bombings; US retaliatory cruise missile strikes against UBL followed.
USS Cole bombing; US had reached no conclusion on UBL role.
State Department cable 215948 to Embassy Islamabad reporting on Frankfurt talks.
Taliban Deputy FM Jalil met Eastham, Hull and Lunstead in Frankfurt on the bin Laden issue; discussions continued Nov 3.
Second day of Frankfurt discussions repeating earlier themes.
Jalil met Ambassador Milam in Islamabad and requested the Frankfurt meeting.
Jalil met Under Secretary Pickering; four issues raised; US gave UBL indictment to Jalil.
East Africa embassy bombings, attributed to UBL by the US.
US retaliatory cruise missile attacks against UBL after embassy bombings.
USS Cole bombing; US investigating possible UBL role.
Recent guilty plea in New York by an accused in the embassy bombing case.
UN Security Council adopted resolution 1267 imposing sanctions on the Taliban over UBL.
Eastham and Jalil repeated discussion of UBL, Security Council sanctions and the Cole investigation.
Eastham told Jalil that retaliation was aimed at a group and infrastructure, not an individual, and that the US preferred a legal path.
Jalil said Mullah Omar had ordered an opium production ban, with a big difference expected next year.
Eastham assessed that a new UN resolution would be introduced shortly with stronger sanctions by year's end.
Jalil said he would pass through Islamabad en route to Afghanistan in a week to 10 days and contact Ambassador Milam.

key_claims: Taliban Deputy FM Jalil said the Taliban wanted to resolve the UBL issue but wanted a US 'gesture' first.
Jalil proposed that the US present its case against UBL in an Afghan court and promised Taliban support.
Jalil said guilt or innocence of UBL did not matter; the Taliban simply wanted to get rid of him.
Eastham refused to delay sanctions or promise US restraint over the USS Cole, and warned the Taliban would be held responsible if UBL attacked US interests.
Eastham said US retaliation would target a group and infrastructure rather than an individual, and that new UN sanctions would likely come by year's end.
Hull warned that other terrorist groups in Afghanistan besides UBL and al-Qa'ida also threatened the US.
The Frankfurt meetings were kept secret from other Taliban ministers on the trade mission.
